# team-ops

Coordinate coding work from the main session with scoped ownership, selective workers, and current execution evidence. Start small edits with `build-implementation-loop`; use `team-lead` for substantial work. Supporting references and the optional Python check runner are bundled inside this package, so the source repository is not required after installation.

Named agent support depends on the host. Use the documented [inline fallback](references/host-compatibility.md) if a role cannot be dispatched. The [coordination contract](skills/team-lead/references/coordination.md) explains briefs, checks, and reuse limits. Research claims and limitations are in the packaged [evidence register](references/research-evidence.md).
